The image displays two side-by-side waterfall charts titled “Emissions from energy (2015, 2023), OECD and OECD partner countries, Gt CO₂e.” Each chart shows emissions in gigatonnes of CO₂ equivalent (Gt CO₂e) on the vertical axis (0–20 scale) and factors driving change on the horizontal axis: “2015 emissions,” “Population,” “GDP,” “Energy intensity,” “GHG intensity,” and “2023 emissions.”

Left chart (“OECD”):  
- 2015 emissions: 12.8 Gt CO₂e (blue bar)  
- Population: +0.51 (green bar)  
- GDP: +1.36 (green bar)  
- Energy intensity: -2.02 (green bar)
